data.name: Plantbringer
data.description: All plants within a 1-mile radius of you grow at double their normal rate and don't suffer from any diseases or maladies. Furthermore, allied plant creatures within 30 feet of you gain fast healing %1. If you use plant shape or wild shape to take the form of a plant, you gain this fast healing in plant form.|MythicLevel
